description: We provide detailed geotechnical assessments to inform foundation design, slope stability, earthworks and soil improvement. Our reports give designers the data needed to reduce risk and avoid costly surprises.
Our environmental team provides baseline studies, full EIA reports, monitoring plans and mitigation strategies tailored to oil & gas and port developments
Our geospatial team transforms survey data into practical maps, 3D terrain models and GIS assets used for design, planning and operations.
We provide onsite supervision for borehole and geotechnical drilling, ensuring data quality, HSE compliance and timely reporting.
Our project managers provide technical oversight to ensure that groundworks, foundations and structural elements meet design intent and site constraints.
We coordinate logistics, local procurement and mobilization for fieldwork — ensuring crews, drilling rigs and equipment arrive on time and stay compliant.
